name: mirage
text: Agreed, and I'm treating it as a bug. What I know so far: the repeat guard does cap the engine's auto-bets and bids, at 2 bets or $100 per side. For bets you tap by hand it only warns (the red X from 10-22), it doesn't block. And on UAPB-FAMU Over 55.5, our logs show one hand tap from you ($1.38), not seven bets. So I can't yet say which path made the other orders. The UAPB-FAMU page has 7 orders and $6.88, and I don't have Novig's order list to match against. The candidates are partial fills, bids filling in pieces, or orders that bypass the guard. I'll check the engine's bid fills and the phone's import for those two games, and I'll tell you the path. Then I'll close it: a hard per-game cap that also applies to bid fills and hand taps on the same side. Tell me if you want taps by hand blocked at the cap too, or still only warned.
